subject: [PATCH v2 2/2] mm/page_alloc: refactor build_node_zonelist() out of build_zonelists()

2026-09-12.patch_summary: This patch refactors the code that builds zonelists in a specific order, extracting it into a new function called build_node_zonelist(). This function takes a node's ID and a list of candidate nodes as input and constructs the fallback list for that node. The original function, build_zonelists(), is simplified to call this new function for each selected node. The patch allows building zonelists from candidate nodemasks instead of just the default N_MEMORY node state list. There are no functional changes in terms of the built zonelists or their ordering.

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch refactors the code that builds zonelists in a node-ordered fashion, extracting it into a new function called build_node_zonelist(). This function takes a nodemask of candidate nodes and builds a zonelist for each selected node directly into the destination zonelist. The fallback order is printed as each node is added. The patch allows building new zonelists from candidate nodemasks instead of just the default N_MEMORY node state list, without introducing any functional changes.
